role: Generates the random galactic Standard Galactic Alphabet style words shown on the enchanting table's item tooltip.
scope_reason: world.conf enchanting = off: the enchanting table is a plain block, so the enchantment name is never generated on either side.
notes: Note the source already draws its Random from netherite.oracle.Det.newRandom, so the oracle keeps the RNG stream deterministic even though the feature is off.
